Notes: While using this medication, laboratory and/or medical tests may be required. Missed Dose: It is crucial to take each dose of this medication as scheduled. If you miss a dose, contact your doctor or pharmacist immediately to establish a new dosing schedule. Storage: Refer to the product instructions and consult your pharmacist for proper storage details. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless directed to do so. Dispose of the product appropriately when it is expired or no longer needed.
